name: Gandalf's Staff
game_text:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
The twilight cost of each <culture>Gandalf</culture> spell is −1.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: Exert Gandalf twice to cancel a skirmish involving him.
flavor_text: “As the wizard passed on ahead up the great steps, he held his staff aloft, and from its tip there came a faint radiance.”
